mapper.select: select * from PRJ_PROJECT_CREDIT_CONDITION p where p.project_id = #{projectId} and not exists (select * from PRJ_PROJECT_CREDIT_CONDITION his where his.credit_condition_id = p.ref_credit_condition_id)

select * from PRJ_PROJECT_CREDIT_CONDITION p where p.project_id = #{hisProjectId} and not exists (select * from PRJ_PROJECT_CREDIT_CONDITION his where his.ref_credit_condition_id = p.credit_condition_id)

select p.conditions, his.conditions as his_condition from PRJ_PROJECT_CREDIT_CONDITION p,PRJ_PROJECT_CREDIT_CONDITION his where p.project_id = #{projectId} and his.credit_condition_id = p.ref_credit_condition_id and his.conditions = p.conditions

select p.conditions, his.conditions as his_condition from PRJ_PROJECT_CREDIT_CONDITION p,PRJ_PROJECT_CREDIT_CONDITION his where p.project_id = #{projectId} and his.credit_condition_id = p.ref_credit_condition_id and his.conditions != p.conditions

SELECT -1 payment_req_id, pcc.CREDIT_CONDITION_ID, pcc.CREDIT_CONDITION_NUMBER, pcc.PROJECT_ID,
pcc.EXEMPTION_CAUSE, pcc.EXEMPTION_FLAG, pcc.APPROVAL_FLAG, pcc.ADD_FLAG, pcc.if_practicable, pcc.end_task_node_id, pcc.new_flag, pcc.CONDITIONS, pcc.CONDITION_TYPE, pcc.implementation_lease, pcc.implementation_situation, (select sc.meaning from sys_code_value_b_v sc where sc.code = 'CSH.PAY_CONDITION_NODE' and pcc.end_task_node_id = sc.code_value) end_task_node_id_n, case when pcc.approval_flag = 'APPROVED' then 'Y' else 'N' end if_immunity, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'CSH.PAYMENT_CONDITION_STATUS' AND v.code_value = pcc.APPROVAL_FLAG) APPROVAL_FLAG_N, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'APPROVAL_TYPE' AND v.code_value = pcc.CONDITION_TYPE) CONDITION_TYPE_n from prj_project_credit_condition pcc
1=1
AND pcc.project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.delete: delete from prj_project_credit_condition p where p.project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT p2.* FROM prj_project_approval p1, prj_approval_condition p2 WHERE p1.PROJECT_ID = p2.PROJECT_ID AND p1.project_id =( SELECT pp.ref_project_id FROM prj_project pp WHERE pp.project_id =#{projectId})
